title: Ropelength-Filtered Reidemeister Graphs
summary: We prove relative smoothing with uniform reach control for one-parameter families of positive-reach $C^{1,1}$ knots and combine it with relative multijet transversality to obtain projection-generic regularization inside strict ropelength sublevels. For families over a compact polyhedron we prove relative smoothing of the slices after an arbitrarily small budget increase. Passing to a lifted Reidemeister multigraph reconstructs the admissible $π_0$ of every strict projection-framed ropelength sublevel.
